integrity: The dimension-saturated restricted-family bound and equality classification have an analytic proof. Finite numerical checks are corroboration, not a universal proof.

mathematical_scope.result: inf W/N=1/(2sqrt(min(k,m−1))); equality iff all outputs are perpendicular to source and nonzero singular values form a full-rank equal set.

scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to rank-at-most-one tuples sharing a source. The unrestricted finite-dimensional Hilbert joint index for k≥m is not determined. Priority risk remains around the inaccessible Drnovšek–Müller 2014 article.
title: Dimension-saturated joint numerical radius for common-source rank-one tuples
